status: Design only; no new fit, cache/market values, current rebuild outcomes or final scenarios read. Not a model change or an executable release.
purpose: Establish which Q1 choices are stable, economically interpretable and supported at each customer horizon; keep questionnaire suitability separate from Q2 execution admission.
facts_from_source: The strict static universe has172 targets on the old5-percentage-point grid plus exact thirds; every asset is>=5%. The problem requires all three assets but does not uniquely impose a5% minimum.

Gamma is a technical training event screen selected from0/.025/.05/.075/.10 by whole-scenario inner evidence; service alpha=.10 is a normative reference, not identified from the supplied loss tolerance.
The raw common menu maximizes coverage, then minimizes maximum and mean growth regret against each profile feasible training oracle; representative profiles are not a sampled customer population.

Unidentified catalogue roles may be completed using a15-year reference growth/CVaR frontier, then named by that reference risk. Label order is not guaranteed at every other horizon or loss definition.

Raw gamma selection and post-refit admission are distinct operations. Effective Q1 Review can arise from unsupported calibration, no inner automatic evidence, lack of risk/liquidity feasibility, or menu-level referral.
Target bill floors30/10/0 for high/medium/low are liquidity proxies under the problem no-withdrawal condition; drifting holdings do not constitute a guaranteed live cash reserve.

phase_A_metadata_stability.inputs: Existing frozen30 job definitions and their exact-own-training static_refits; no market parsing or new optimization needed for this phase.
phase_A_metadata_stability.counts: Six parent contexts: full120 plus5 outer96. Each has4 dynamic-inner fits and1 refit, yielding30 static fit bundles and150 profile-fit assignments. Full120 inner fitN90; outer96 inner fitN72.
phase_A_metadata_stability.outputs: All30 fits retained; per-role weight ranges and distinct targets; gamma/label distributions; raw-to-effective transitions; exact Review reasons; no averaging profile labels into a number.
phase_A_metadata_stability.interpretation: Fit variation is sensitivity to training subsets and overlapping selection contexts. These are not30 independent deployments or a confidence interval for a population preference. Two identical target/assignment vectors do not identify a unique gamma.

phase_B_own_horizon_OOF.population: Primary5 outer refits only. Their24-ID evaluation sets partition original1-120 once. Apply all5 questionnaire profiles:120×5=600 original scenario-profile records, including every Review/noninvestment.
phase_B_own_horizon_OOF.fit_scope: Use each outer fit own menu and effective labels; no full120 target/assignment inheritance. Complete static training/calibration must exclude the respective actual24IDs.
phase_B_own_horizon_OOF.policy: Static own-target annual restoration with stated exact initial/later fees, continued after an L crossing as a named product reference. It is not the dynamic Q2 pending policy or an execution approval.
phase_B_own_horizon_OOF.horizons: A5,B15,C30,D25,E6, each with its own L/liquidity category. Annualize growth over original own H and preserve initial100 real peak.
phase_B_own_horizon_OOF.financial_denominators: Effective Review retains financialNULL. Report original120 per profile, assigned count and reasons, plus conditional invested metrics; separately report raw menu assignment if diagnostic, without replacing effective results.
phase_B_own_horizon_OOF.metrics: Real median/P10 CAGR; mean log growth; ordinary within-path real-return volatility; real annual MDD median/P90/fractional CVaR90; strict MDD-L>1e-12 event fraction; exact fee/trade fraction where saved or independently reconstructable.
phase_B_own_horizon_OOF.comparators: Own-profile horizon exact-thirds static annual reference on all120 and on identical assigned IDs; optionally the fixed old full120 menu only as a previously development-derived descriptive reference, never an independent outer learner.
phase_B_own_horizon_OOF.no_equal_H_ranking: Portfolio names may refer to a common15year reference ordering. Do not infer that E6 is safer than C30 from raw event frequencies, or claim a label dominates at all horizons.
phase_B_own_horizon_OOF.coverage_vs_risk: Do not call profiles with zeroassigned zero-risk. Do not remove B/C/E unfavorable tails or A/D Review. A fitted training oracle remains a training optimization comparator, not a best-on-heldout portfolio.

phase_C_parameter_resolution.gamma_count_resolution: For every actual trainingN/gamma report floor(gamma*N+1e-12), actual eligible candidate sets and chosen action/menu/assignment vectors. Several gamma values may map to the same permissible event counts or identical behavior.
phase_C_parameter_resolution.global_tie_bands: Use saved exact global tolerance-band definitions. Distinguish equal objective, near-equal growth and complete behavior equivalence; do not enlarge the top set because heldout outcomes later look similar.
phase_C_parameter_resolution.refit_instability: Track whether a gamma with favorable inner evidence yields a materially different full-training menu/admission. This diagnoses nonunique selection/refit behavior; it does not by itself justify rescuing a rejected fit.
phase_C_parameter_resolution.boundary_arithmetic_check: Use subtraction-before-comparison MDD-L>1e-12 consistently in new diagnostics. Some older saved detail-count source uses MDD>L+tol; if a constructed floating boundary differs, disclose it without modifying old evidence or retroactively changing labels.
phase_C_parameter_resolution.no_psychological_identification: Gamma,5%grid resolution,15year role reference and liquidity floors are model conventions. A precise selected gamma is not an elicited customer risk-aversion coefficient.

optional_new_sensitivity_requires_separa.liquidity: Exactly three predeclared cases: lower floors(high.25,medium.05,low0), retained(.30,.10,0), higher(.35,.15,0). Refit all static inner menus/oracles jointly, maintain long-only/three-positive-assets, same alpha and raw objective; evaluate the complete new learner. These are normative proxy sensitivities, not calibrated spending needs.
optional_new_sensitivity_requires_separa.selection_boundary: Do not choose the easiest floors from outer outcomes. Report the retained convention plus both directions and any loss of service. Any adoption of a different convention is a new model version requiring its own justification/evaluation.
optional_new_sensitivity_requires_separa.partition_stability: If adding folds, predeclare a small finite ID-only seed set and rerun the complete static learning/calibration mapping. Keep each repeat separate and track overlapping original IDs; repeated rows are not additional independent markets.
optional_new_sensitivity_requires_separa.bootstrap_warning: Naively resampling scenario indices with replacement then splitting duplicated rows leaks the same original path between fitting and validation. A complete-learner bootstrap must group all copies of the same originalID and preserve multiplicity weights, or be labeled a conditional fixed-fit bootstrap. Do not improvise this during execution.
optional_new_sensitivity_requires_separa.budget: Prefer metadata stability and existing-cache own-H OOF first. A finer continuous-weight grid, extra market regime models or broad normative parameter search is a separate scientific project, not a diagnostic repair.

pure_tests_before_any_new_numeric_summar: Profile horizon/L/liquidity mapping and local172-to-original232 indices.
All outer original-ID/profile pairs exactly once; no evaluation ID in its static fit.
Raw vs effective labels and Review reasons remain distinct; zeroassigned statisticsNULL.
Gamma-to-event-count granularity and exact tolerance-boundary consistency.
Shared15year risk ordering does not override profile own-H risk metrics.
All saved-source/input hashes fixed at start/end; all final IDs rejected before parsing.
